title: Worker request v1
description: docs/02_SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md, 'Worker contract v1'. Implemented in SSDShredder.Worker.Protocol.RequestParser/WireRequest. Unknown fields, duplicate keys, wrong types and invalid UTF-8 are rejected before this shape is even considered (RequestParser.AllowedKeys).

target.description: Absolute local path (inspect/shred), vault UUID (vault-status/vault-close), canonical volume GUID path (probe-volume, private), or null (vault-init).

confirmed.description: Only shred and vault-close accept confirmed=true, and both require it before mutation.

selectionToken.description: Required on a connection shred that follows an inspect on the same connection; absent everywhere else. 32 lowercase hex characters.
